strings.zh: 我是培育屋的爷爷。{SCROLL}在这里可以照顾大家的精灵哦。{SCROLL}如果有什么需要的话,{NEWLINE}跟婆婆说就可以了。
strings.en: I’m the Day-Care Man.{SCROLL}We look after the precious Pokémon{NEWLINE}of other Trainers.{SCROLL}If you’d like us to raise your{NEWLINE}Pokémon, have a word with my wife.

strings.zh: 嘿！你啊。{SCROLL}放在这里的精灵{NEWLINE}成长得很好⋯⋯什么！{SCROLL}精灵居然带着蛋！{SCROLL}从哪里来的还不知道。{NEWLINE}你的精灵所持有的蛋,{SCROLL}想要吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Ah, it’s you!{SCROLL}We were raising your Pokémon,{NEWLINE}and my goodness, were we surprised!{SCROLL}Your Pokémon was holding an Egg!{SCROLL}We don’t know how it got there,{NEWLINE}but your Pokémon had it.{SCROLL}You do want it, don’t you? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 嘿,你啊！终于来了。{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:0}很健康哦。
strings.en: Ah, it’s you! Good to see you.{NEWLINE}Your {VAR:0100:0}’s doing just fine.

strings.zh: 那么我就收下了,{NEWLINE}谢谢。
strings.en: Well then, I’ll hang on to it.{NEWLINE}Thanks!

strings.zh: 带着的精灵已经满了啊⋯⋯{CLEAR}整理一下手头的精灵再来吧。
strings.en: You have no room for it right now...{NEWLINE}Come back when you’ve made room.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}从培育屋的爷爷{NEWLINE}那里得到了蛋！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0} received the Egg from{NEWLINE}the Day-Care Man.

strings.zh: 要好好培育哦！
strings.en: You take good care of it.

strings.zh: 对了,你的{VAR:0100:0}呢。{SCROLL}好像和{VAR:0103:1}那里的{VAR:0100:2}{NEWLINE}玩得很高兴呢。{SCROLL}而且还收到了信哦。
strings.en: Oh, and about your {VAR:0100:0}...{SCROLL}It seems to be having fun playing with{NEWLINE}{VAR:0103:1}’s {VAR:0100:2}.{SCROLL}It even got a letter!

strings.zh: 想取回精灵的时候,{NEWLINE}和婆婆说就可以了。
strings.en: If you want your Pokémon back,{NEWLINE}just have a word with my wife.

strings.zh: 噢,你啊！终于来了啊。{SCROLL}{VAR:0100:0}和{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:1}都很健康哦！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Ah, it’s you!{NEWLINE}Good to see you!{SCROLL}Your {VAR:0100:0} and {VAR:0100:1}{NEWLINE}are doing just fine.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 那我收下了。{NEWLINE}其实你是想要的吧？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: I really will keep it.{NEWLINE}You do want this Egg, yes? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 一定要好好培养啊！{SCROLL}不过居然能发现蛋⋯⋯{SCROLL}哎呀呀,不过搞不好{NEWLINE}还会再发现的！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Take good care of it!{SCROLL}To think we found an Egg...{SCROLL}Oh my, but we may well find another!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0439/11 | RV061: meaning: zh 居然能发现蛋…搞不好还会再发现 = surprise, then maybe another; US invented doubt and certainty (D-1825)

strings.zh: 那我就收下了,{NEWLINE}谢谢啦。{SCROLL}不过居然能发现蛋⋯⋯{SCROLL}哎呀呀,不过搞不好{NEWLINE}还会再发现的！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Well all right then, I’ll take it.{NEWLINE}Thank you.{SCROLL}To think we found an Egg...{SCROLL}Oh my, but we may well find another!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}啊⋯⋯{NEWLINE}等你寄存的精灵生蛋之后{CLEAR}我会立刻电话{CLEAR}联系你的,没问题吧？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}...{NEWLINE}Once the Pokémon you left with us lay{CLEAR}an Egg, I’ll call you right away.{CLEAR}Is that all right? {VAR:0200:0}
strings.notes: US 0439/13 | RV061: meaning: zh 生蛋之后 立刻电话联系 = once they lay an Egg I'll call right away; US 'holding an Egg', no 'right away' (D-1826)

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}啊⋯⋯{NEWLINE}等你寄存的精灵{CLEAR}生蛋之后{CLEAR}我会立刻电话联系你的,{NEWLINE}没问题吧？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}...{NEWLINE}Once the Pokémon you left with us lay{CLEAR}an Egg, I’ll call you right away.{CLEAR}Is that all right? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 好！{NEWLINE}交给我吧！{SCROLL}你要想培育什么精灵的话{NEWLINE}就去找婆婆吧。
strings.en: You can leave it up to us!{SCROLL}Any Pokémon you’d like to have raised{NEWLINE}you can leave in my wife’s care.

strings.zh: 原来如此,也行。{SCROLL}你要想培育什么精灵的话{NEWLINE}就去找婆婆吧。
strings.en: I see. Well, that’s fine.{SCROLL}Any Pokémon you’d like to have raised{NEWLINE}you can leave in my wife’s care.

strings.zh: ２只精灵都好像不错呢！
strings.en: The two seem to get along very well.

strings.zh: ２只精灵的感情好像很好。
strings.en: The two seem to get along.

strings.zh: ２只精灵的关系好像不太好哦。
strings.en: The two don’t seem to like each{NEWLINE}other much.

strings.zh: ２只精灵{NEWLINE}都只自顾自地玩⋯⋯
strings.en: The two just play on their own...
strings.notes: US 0439/20 | RV061: meaning: zh 只自顾自地玩 = each plays on its own; US 'with other Pokémon' (D-1827)

strings.zh: 我是培育屋的婆婆。{SCROLL}可以帮你们培育{NEWLINE}你们的精灵的哦。{SCROLL}想培育哪个呢？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: I’m the Day-Care Lady.{NEWLINE}We can raise Pokémon for you.{SCROLL}Would you like us to raise your{NEWLINE}Pokémon? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 要培育哪个？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Which Pokémon should we raise for{NEWLINE}you?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 那么,{VAR:0100:0}就暂时{NEWLINE}放我这里了。{SCROLL}过一段时间后再来吧。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Fine, we’ll raise your {VAR:0100:0}{NEWLINE}for a while.{SCROLL}Come back for it later.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 可以寄存２只精灵哦,{NEWLINE}还是要寄存１只精灵吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: We can raise two of your Pokémon.{NEWLINE}Would you like us to raise another? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 噢！爷爷在找你呢。
strings.en: Ah, there you are!{NEWLINE}My husband was looking for you.

strings.zh: 是吗,{NEWLINE}那么下次再来吧。
strings.en: Oh, fine, then.{NEWLINE}Come again.

strings.zh: 好像钱不够呢⋯⋯
strings.en: You don’t have enough money...

strings.zh: 要取回１只精灵吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Do you want to take back the other{NEWLINE}one, too? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 那么下次再来吧。
strings.en: Very good.{NEWLINE}Come again.

strings.zh: 噢,你啊！终于来了,{NEWLINE}你的精灵很健康哦。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Ah, it’s you! Good to see you.{NEWLINE}Your Pokémon is doing just fine.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: {VAR:0100:0}的等级,{NEWLINE}已经提升了{VAR:0133:1}级了。{SCROLL}
strings.en: By level, your {VAR:0100:0} has{NEWLINE}grown by about {VAR:0133:1}.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 带着的精灵已经满了啊⋯⋯{CLEAR}整理一下手头的精灵后再来吧。
strings.en: Your Pokémon team is full.{NEWLINE}Make room, then come see me.

strings.zh: 要领取{VAR:0100:0}的话,{NEWLINE}需要金钱{VAR:0135:1}¥哦。{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: If you want your {VAR:0100:0} back,{NEWLINE}it will cost ${VAR:0135:1}. {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 谢谢！{NEWLINE}那么,请将精灵带走吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Excellent!{NEWLINE}Here’s your Pokémon.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:1}在培育屋的婆婆那{NEWLINE}接过了{VAR:0100:0}！{SCROLL}
strings.en: {VAR:0103:1} took {VAR:0100:0} back{NEWLINE}from the Day-Care Lady.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 嗯？{NEWLINE}精灵好像就剩１只了呢。{SCROLL}要再来哦。
strings.en: Oh? But you only have one{NEWLINE}Pokémon with you.{SCROLL}Come back another time.
strings.notes: US 0439/36 | RV061: addition: US 'You can't go off without a Pokémon' not in zh

strings.zh: 要领取精灵吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Do you want your Pokémon back? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 寄存那个精灵的话,{NEWLINE}就会变得不能参战了哦。{SCROLL}要再来哦
strings.en: If you leave me that Pokémon,{NEWLINE}what are you gonna battle with?{SCROLL}Come back another time.

strings.zh: 嗯？{NEWLINE}你再把那只精灵也寄存的话,{CLEAR}那么就只剩下１只精灵了。{SCROLL}多带些精灵过来比较好哦？
strings.en: Huh?{SCROLL}If you leave that Pokémon with{NEWLINE}me too, you’ll be left with just one.{SCROLL}You’d be better off bringing more{NEWLINE}Pokémon along.
strings.notes: | RV061: meaning: zh 多带些精灵过来比较好 = better to bring more Pokémon; US 'catch some more, if I do say so myself'

strings.zh: 哎呀,我说你啊,{NEWLINE}那可是蛋哦！
strings.en: Now, now.{NEWLINE}That is merely an Egg!

strings.zh: 那么{VAR:0100:0}就{NEWLINE}暂时放我这里了哦。{SCROLL}过一段时间后再来拿吧。
strings.en: Fine, we’ll raise your {VAR:0100:0}{NEWLINE}for a while.{SCROLL}Come back for it later.
